description: Reference case: CA ordination of NW Mexico LFOs (2001–2010, tax_resolution='nombre_especie'). Expected to reproduce spatial structure comparable to Erisman et al. (2011) — MLG > 3 SD, k_optimal_kl near 8, CA axis 2 correlating positively with latitude and negatively with longitude.

reference_case.comparison_note: Erisman et al. (2011) used 2001-2005 data, regional common names, CANOCO v4.5. Direct numerical comparison may not be possible, but spatial gradient pattern should be qualitatively consistent.
